_doc: City/community hero + card video curation for scripts/sync-city-videos.mjs. Each entry maps a slug to a Drive clip; geo_tags carry BOTH the community AND its parent city (Matt directive: a community video also gets the city tag it belongs to). Run: node --env-file=.env.local scripts/sync-city-videos.mjs [--only <slug>]. The Area Guide clips have NO voiceover and are used as-created. The '1080p - h.265.mov' versions are LANDSCAPE (16:9) — preferred for cards; we re-encode them to web h.264 mp4 with the homepage hero grade.
